confirmed_gaps.root_cause_hypothesis: Theory used NECTAR tail-50 line count × average token/line estimates. Actual NECTAR.md has dense structured entries (few prose sentences per finding) + compression from HEADLINE/OBSERVATION tags. Token count per line is lower than estimated prose density assumed. Additionally: tail-50 often does not span full 1200-line file in practice — typical sessions have <600 lines.
confirmed_gaps.action: ACCEPTED — formula updated. New baseline 1200 tokens is accurate. Recheck after 3 sessions if NECTAR file grows significantly.
confirmed_gaps.equilibrium_check: PASS — lower injection cost = lower f(0) overhead = positive emergence

confirmed_gaps.root_cause_hypothesis: Theory assumed HONEY.md was a flat document read in full (~1500 tokens). Actual architecture: two-tier HONEY (global + project) is COMPRESSED at injection time via CLAUDE_CORE extraction — only essential governance rules injected, not full HONEY.md prose. Additionally: HONEY.md has aggressive token budget (<=5K total) enforced by equilibrium rules; actual content is denser/shorter than projected. The 7.5x gap suggests HONEY injection is nearly negligible overhead.
confirmed_gaps.action: ACCEPTED — formula updated. New baseline 200 tokens. Flag: if HONEY.md grows beyond 5K budget ceiling, re-measure.
confirmed_gaps.equilibrium_check: PASS — HONEY compression is a designed feature, not a bug. 200 token overhead is well within acceptable f(0) equilibrium.

confirmed_gaps.root_cause_hypothesis: Scout 4 was dispatched as a general-purpose agent without shell execution capability. Quality gate measurement requires repeated manifest sampling (N>=20) with variance calculation. Without shell access, agent could only do N=1 conceptual pass. This is a spawn design gap: quality gate measurement tasks REQUIRE shell-capable agent (data-scientist or ai-engineer).
confirmed_gaps.action: BLOCKED — emit bundle for re-run with shell-capable agent. Do not mutate gate values without data.
confirmed_gaps.equilibrium_check: CORRECT to block — mutating gates without evidence violates fundamental governance rule

confirmed_gaps.root_cause_hypothesis: Scout 1 correctly identified the measurement methodology (token counting via Claude usage API or context fill deltas per spawn) but lacked execution environment to run it. confirmed_gaps.action: QUEUED — next_task_queued = spawn-cost-execution with shell-capable agent
